unsupported_wording: 'Hot-desert summer' only partly fits: traverses ran June 18 to October 25, 2025; the two October 25 traverses were at ~24–25 °C (Table 1 cols d, e). Note also the paper is internally inconsistent on which four sites: abstract says 'Five traverses at four facilities'; Methods/Results list CyrusOne, Aligned, Digital Realty (Chandler) and NTT PH1 (Mesa), while Fig. 1 shows Apple, NTT, Iron Mountain, CyrusOne. Also the abstract says 'up to 500 m' while Conclusions say '>250 m'.
note: Peer-reviewed; 'short communication' is the paper's own term. Facility MW figures are operator claims cited by the authors (NTT fact sheet [11]; CyrusOne website [14]). 8–14 °C and 1 °C/100 W/m² are cited from other sources, as the claim says.
